description: This file contains SSL utility functions for OpenSSL error handling, version detection, and certificate chain setup within the net namespace, used in Chromium project.

classes.name: SslSetClearMask
classes.description: A class to manage SSL set and clear flags.

classes.name: OpenSSLNetErrorLibSingleton
classes.description: Singleton class to manage OpenSSL error library registration.

methods.name: ConfigureFlag
methods.description: Sets or clears a specific SSL flag based on the boolean state.

methods.name: OpenSSLPutNetError
methods.description: Logs a network error into OpenSSL's error queue with location info.

methods.name: MapOpenSSLError
methods.description: Maps OpenSSL error codes to Chromium net error codes.

methods.name: MapOpenSSLErrorWithDetails
methods.description: Maps OpenSSL errors to net errors with detailed info.

methods.name: NetLogOpenSSLError
methods.description: Logs OpenSSL errors into Chromium's net log.

methods.name: GetNetSSLVersion
methods.description: Returns the SSL/TLS version used by the SSL object.

methods.name: SetSSLChainAndKey
methods.description: Sets the certificate chain and private key for an SSL connection.
